objective: An extensible, code-only 2D and 3D atlas platform for neurosurgical anatomy learning and teaching
dataset_policy: Uniform adapter contracts and individual licenses; scope decisions do not define permission-based dataset classes
existing_files_policy: Disease data were removed from project storage at user request; preserve user originals and other datasets
future_modules: Normal-anatomy specialist expansion is authorized; disease support requires a later scope change and is not a current acceptance prerequisite.
